Definition: from G5064; pertaining to the fourth day:--four days.
BiblicalUsage: The word tetartaîos is the Bible's way of saying four days. In John 11:39, he hath been dead four days.
TheologicalSignificance: Lazarus four days in the grave tells me no situation is too far gone for Jesus to walk into.
